methods.label: Check the exponent and coefficient
methods.explanation: An inverse proportional function requires the exponent to be \(-1\), so \(m^2-2=-1\), giving \(m=\pm1\). Also, \(m+1\ne0\), so \(m\ne-1\). Therefore, \(m=1\), in which case \(y=2/x\).
methods.levelReason: The method combines the inverse proportional definition, negative integer exponents, and direct square-root solving, all available by Grade 9.
